q: 嵌入向量在系统设计里的核心含义是什么？
q_en: What does an embedding mean in system design?
options: 把所有类别转成独立的 one-hot 维度
只用于压缩图片文件体积
把实体编码成可比较的稠密数值向量
把数据库表整体序列化成 JSON
why: 核心是稠密向量能算相似度，把实体压缩成可比较的表示。它的价值在向量空间结构，不在某个维度的人工含义。
why_en: An embedding is a dense numeric vector that captures an entity's meaning so similar entities end up close together.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Entity[Entity] --> Encoder[Encoder]
  Encoder --> Vec[Dense vector]
  Vec --> Compare[Similarity]
  Compare --> Use[Retrieve or rank]
options_en: Turn every category into its own one-hot dimension.
Compress image files only.
Encode an entity into a dense, comparable numeric vector.
Serialize a whole database table into JSON.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一组数值表示一个实体（用户、物品、词、文档等）的稠密向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a dense vector of numbers that represents an entity such as a user, item, word, or document.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个类别分配一个独立维度、其余维度为零的稀疏编码方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: One-hot encoding gives each category its own dimension, with every other dimension set to zero.

optionExplanations: 这说的是 one-hot：每个类别占一个孤立维度，学不到实体间的共享相似性。
这把 embedding 误当成图片压缩工具，混淆了向量表示和文件体积压缩。
对：稠密向量把实体压成几十到几百维，相近实体自然靠得近，可以直接拿去算相似度。
序列化只是把结构转成 JSON 文本，读不出向量夹角或距离，不能拿来算相似度。
optionExplanations_en: That's one-hot: each category gets its own isolated dimension, so it never learns shared similarity across entities.
This mistakes embeddings for an image-compression trick — a different problem entirely.
Right: an embedding packs an entity into a dense vector of a few hundred numbers, so similar entities land close together and you can score similarity directly.
Serializing a table to JSON keeps the data readable but gives no vector angle or distance to compare, so it isn't a similarity representation.

scenario: 系统要表示 1000 万用户；one-hot 给每个用户一个独立维度，embedding 学一个低维稠密向量。
scenario_en: The system must represent 10 million users; one-hot assigns one dimension per user, while embeddings learn low-dimensional dense vectors.
q: one-hot 与 embedding 在共享结构上的核心区别是？
q_en: What is the key structural difference between one-hot and embeddings?
options: one-hot 和 embedding 都能共享行为结构
one-hot 每维孤立，embedding 学到可迁移共享结构
one-hot 维度低，embedding 维度反而更高
新用户下两者都必须新增一个维度
why: 决定性维度是共享结构：one-hot 每维独立，新实体要开新维；embedding 学到共享表示，相似实体自然靠近。
why_en: Embeddings beat one-hot because they learn shared, transferable structure instead of one isolated dimension per entity.
tradeoff: 稀疏独立维度 vs 稠密共享结构
options_en: Both one-hot and embeddings naturally share behavioral structure.
One-hot dimensions are isolated, while embeddings learn transferable shared structure.
One-hot has lower dimensionality than embeddings.
Both require adding a new dimension for every new user.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个类别分配独立维度、其余为零的稀疏编码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: One-hot encoding assigns each category its own dimension, with all other dimensions set to zero.

termDefinitions.meaning: 低维稠密向量，让相似实体在向量空间彼此靠近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a low-dimensional dense vector that places similar entities close together.

optionExplanations: 这误以为 one-hot 也能沉淀共性，但它每一维只绑定一个用户，彼此互不关联，学不出可迁移的结构。
对：one-hot 每维只代表一个实体，而 embedding 让相似用户共享参数，新实体也能借到这份结构。
这把维度高低说反了——one-hot 才是随用户数线性膨胀的高维稀疏表示，embedding 反而更低维。
这也说反了：新用户在 one-hot 下确实要开新维，但 embedding 可以直接用特征编码复用已有向量空间。
optionExplanations_en: This wrongly assumes one-hot builds shared structure too, but each dimension is tied to one user and shares nothing with the rest.
Right: one-hot isolates every user in its own dimension, while embeddings learn parameters that similar users can share, including new ones.
This reverses reality — one-hot is the side that grows huge and sparse with user count, not embeddings.
Also reversed: new users do need a fresh one-hot dimension, but an embedding can reuse the existing space via feature encoding.

scenario: 你要向面试官解释为什么选 embedding 而不是 one-hot 表示实体。
scenario_en: You need to explain to an interviewer why you would represent entities with embeddings instead of one-hot encoding.
q: 补全 embedding 相比 one-hot 的关键优势。
q_en: Fill in the main advantage of embeddings over one-hot.
text: One-hot 为每个实体分配独立维度；embedding 学到{{低维稠密}}表示，并让相似实体{{距离更近}}。
why: One-hot 每维独立、无共享；embedding 用低维稠密表示，让相似样本共享参数和位置。
why_en: Unlike one-hot's isolated dimensions, embeddings learn a low-dimensional dense representation that places similar entities close together.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个类别分配独立维度、其余为零的稀疏编码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: One-hot encoding assigns each category its own dimension, with all other dimensions set to zero.

termDefinitions.meaning: 低维稠密向量，让相似实体在向量空间彼此靠近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a low-dimensional dense vector that places similar entities close together.

scenario: 你在设计视频推荐召回，需要解释“相似”到底由什么决定。
scenario_en: You are designing video recommendation retrieval and need to explain what actually defines similarity.
q: 解释向量相似度时最该强调什么？
q_en: When explaining vector similarity, what should you emphasize first?
options: 相似度永远等于标题关键词是否重合
相似度只由向量维度数量决定
相似度由数据库主键顺序决定
相似度由训练目标定义，不等于人类语义相似
why: 决定性是训练信号：共看、共买等目标各自定义不同的“相似”。面试先讲目标，再讲向量本身。
why_en: Similarity in an embedding space comes from the training objective, not from the word 'embedding' itself.
whenOtherWins: 如果任务是精确 ID 查找或权限校验，向量相似度不是核心，主键或规则会赢。
tradeoff: 训练目标定义的相似 vs 人类直觉的语义相似
options_en: Similarity always equals overlapping title keywords.
Similarity is decided only by the number of vector dimensions.
Similarity follows the database primary-key order.
Similarity is defined by the training objective, not by human semantic meaning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一组数值表示一个实体的稠密向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding is a dense vector of numbers that represents an entity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从海量候选中快速找出可能相关的一小部分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Retrieval narrows a huge candidate pool down to a small set of likely relevant items.

optionExplanations: 关键词重合只能当弱基线，两个视频标题不同但行为模式很像时，这条完全失效。
维度数量决定向量能装多少信息，不能单独定义'相似'到底指什么。
主键顺序只是存储编号，跟两个视频是否该被认为相似毫无关系。
对：共看、共买这类训练信号才定义了'相似'，回答时先说清楚这个目标，再讲向量本身。
optionExplanations_en: Keyword overlap is only a weak baseline — two videos with different titles but similar viewing behavior wouldn't match.
Dimension count sets how much information a vector can hold, but it doesn't define what 'similar' means.
Primary-key order is just a storage number and has nothing to do with whether two videos are actually alike.
Right: signals like co-watch or co-purchase are what define similarity, so name that objective before talking about the vector itself.

q: 矩阵分解把用户-物品交互矩阵近似成什么？
q_en: What does matrix factorization approximate a user-item matrix as?
options: 用户矩阵 U 与物品矩阵 V 的低秩乘积
每个用户单独训练一棵决策树
所有点击行为的倒排索引
只保留热门物品的固定队列
why: 决定性是低秩约束：U·Vᵀ 近似稀疏交互矩阵 R，逼模型共享用户/物品的行为模式。
why_en: Matrix factorization approximates the sparse interaction matrix as a low-rank product of a user matrix and an item matrix.
options_en: A low-rank product of a user matrix U and an item matrix V.
A separate decision tree trained for every user.
An inverted index over every click event.
A fixed queue containing only popular items.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大而稀疏的交互矩阵近似成两个低秩矩阵的乘积。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Matrix factorization approximates a large sparse interaction matrix as the product of two low-rank matrices.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用远小于原始规模的维度数来近似矩阵，逼共享结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Low-rank means approximating a matrix with far fewer dimensions than its original size, forcing shared structure.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按特征分裂做预测的树状模型，不产出向量表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A decision tree is a branching model that predicts by splitting on features, not by producing vector embeddings.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从词映射到包含该词的文档列表的检索结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inverted index maps each term to the list of documents containing it, used for keyword search.

optionExplanations: 对：把稀疏的交互矩阵拆成两个低秩矩阵相乘，逼着用户和物品共用同一套隐向量。
决策树按单个用户单独建模，不产出可共享的向量，规模上也不现实。
倒排索引是按关键词找文档的检索结构，跟压缩交互矩阵是两码事。
热门队列只保留少数爆款，既不个性化也学不出任何向量表示。
optionExplanations_en: Right: it splits the sparse interaction matrix into two low-rank matrices whose product forces users and items to share the same latent vectors.
A decision tree modeled per user produces no shared vector at all, and training one tree per user doesn't scale.
An inverted index maps keywords to documents for search — a different structure from compressing an interaction matrix.
A fixed popularity queue only keeps a handful of hits; it has no personalization and produces no vectors.

q: 补全矩阵分解的典型形状。
q_en: Fill in the typical shape of matrix factorization.
text: 若 R 是 users × items，矩阵分解学习 U: users × {{k}} 和 V: items × {{k}}，使 U·Vᵀ 近似 {{R}}。
why: k 通常远小于用户数和物品数，逼模型压缩出共享的行为模式。
why_en: The rank k is far smaller than the number of users or items, forcing the model to compress shared behavior patterns.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分解出的向量维度，通常远小于用户数或物品数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: k is the embedding rank, the vector dimension used in the factorization, usually far smaller than the number of users or items.

scenario: 你需要给推荐系统一个便宜、能解释的召回 baseline，只有用户-物品交互日志。
scenario_en: You need a cheap, explainable retrieval baseline for a recommender, and the only signal is user-item interaction logs.
q: 召回 baseline 最合适的起点是？
q_en: What is the best starting baseline for retrieval?
options: 从零训练大型多模态 Transformer
只按视频标题做关键词匹配
矩阵分解学向量，再接近邻搜索召回
给每个用户手写推荐规则
why: 决定性是只有交互日志且要便宜可解释，矩阵分解能直接从矩阵学向量。它不是终态方案，只是可比较的地板线。
why_en: Matrix factorization is a cheap, mature retrieval baseline when the only signal is a sparse interaction matrix.
whenOtherWins: 如果有丰富文本/图像/序列信号且质量要求更高，两塔或序列模型会更有上限。
tradeoff: 便宜可解释的基线 vs 更高质量但更贵的表示
options_en: Train a large multimodal transformer from scratch.
Match candidates only by title keywords.
Learn vectors via matrix factorization, then retrieve with nearest-neighbor search.
Hand-write recommendation rules per user.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大而稀疏的交互矩阵近似成两个低秩矩阵的乘积。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Matrix factorization approximates a large sparse interaction matrix as the product of two low-rank matrices.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于注意力机制的神经网络架构，常用于文本/多模态编码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A transformer is a neural network architecture built on attention, commonly used to encode text or multimodal input.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在向量空间里快速找出与查询最接近的候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Approximate nearest-neighbor search quickly finds the candidates closest to a query vector.

optionExplanations: 数据够丰富、算力和标注预算都充足、要冲质量上限时才该从零训练大模型，这里只有交互日志，成本对不上。
语料只有标题、想快速上一个粗过滤时关键词匹配能用，但它读不出用户是否真的喜欢，浪费了已有的交互信号。
对：只有交互矩阵、要快又要能讲清楚原理时，矩阵分解直接从矩阵学出向量，是最省成本的起步方案。
用户量很小、策略可以人工维护时手写规则能顶一阵，但规模变大后维护成本会线性甚至更快增长，学不到长期模式。
optionExplanations_en: Training a large model from scratch fits once you have rich data, compute, and a quality ceiling to chase — here you only have interaction logs, so the cost doesn't pay off.
Keyword matching works as a rough filter when all you have is a title, but it can't tell if a user actually liked something, wasting the interaction signal you already have.
Right: with only an interaction matrix and a need for a fast, explainable start, matrix factorization learns vectors straight from the matrix at low cost.
Hand-written rules can hold up while the user base is tiny and rules stay manageable, but maintenance cost grows at least linearly and never learns long-term patterns.

q: 两塔模型为什么适合大规模召回？
q_en: Why do two-tower models scale for large retrieval?
options: 它对每次请求的全量候选都做一次精排
候选向量离线算好，在线只编码查询再搜索
它训练时完全不需要用到任何负样本
它只适合候选规模比较小的场景
why: 决定性是候选向量可离线预计算入索引，在线只跑查询塔加近邻搜索，才能毫秒级查亿级候选。
why_en: A two-tower model scales retrieval because candidate embeddings are precomputed offline and only the query tower runs online.
tradeoff: 候选离线预计算 vs 在线全量精排
diagram:
flowchart LR
  User[User or query] --> QT[Query tower]
  Item[Items] --> IT[Item tower]
  IT --> ANN[ANN index]
  QT --> Search[Nearest search]
  ANN --> Search
  Search --> TopK[Top K]
options_en: It reranks the entire candidate pool from scratch on every single request.
Candidate vectors are precomputed offline, so online serving only encodes the query and searches.
It supposedly needs no negative samples at all during training.
It only fits scenarios with a fairly small candidate pool.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用两个独立编码器分别编码查询和候选，输出到同一向量空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-tower model uses two separate encoders, one for the query and one for the candidate, that output into the same vector space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时用来代表“不相关”的候选，帮助模型学习区分边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative samples are candidates labeled as not relevant during training, used to teach the model a decision boundary.

optionExplanations: 全量精排每次请求都要算完所有候选，候选量到亿级时延迟根本扛不住。
对：候选向量提前离线算好放进索引，线上只用查询塔编码一次再做近邻搜索，延迟才压得下来。
对比学习恰恰依赖负样本区分正负对，去掉负样本模型学不出决策边界。
两塔的规模优势恰恰在候选量特别大的场景才体现出来，小数据用不上这套机制。
optionExplanations_en: Full reranking has to score every candidate on each request, which can't survive once the pool reaches billions of items.
Right: candidate vectors are precomputed offline into an index, so online serving only encodes the query once and searches — that's what keeps latency low.
Contrastive training actually depends on negatives to separate positive from negative pairs; drop them and the model learns no boundary.
Two-tower's scaling advantage only shows up once the candidate pool is huge — small datasets don't need this machinery.

q: 补全两塔模型的关键约束。
q_en: Fill in the key constraint of a two-tower model.
text: 用户塔和物品塔可以结构不同，但输出必须进入{{同一个向量空间}}，这样 dot product 才能表示{{匹配分数}}。
why: 两塔维度或语义空间若不一致，点积就没有训练意义。
why_en: If the two towers don't share one output space, the dot product between them has no trained meaning.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个向量对应元素相乘再求和，常用来打相似度分数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dot product multiplies two vectors element-wise and sums the results, commonly used as a similarity score.

scenario: 搜索系统需要语义召回：在线 query 千变万化，文档库很大但更新相对慢。
scenario_en: A search system needs semantic retrieval: live queries vary constantly, while the document corpus is large and changes slowly.
q: 应优先用哪种 embedding serving 方式？
q_en: Which embedding serving pattern should you choose first?
options: 每次请求重新编码全部文档
只用 SQL LIKE 做全表扫描
把所有可能查询提前枚举好
文档离线编码入索引，查询在线编码
why: 决定性是文档库大且更新慢、查询侧多变，离线编码文档、在线只编码查询是语义召回的标准结构。
why_en: For semantic retrieval, stable documents should be embedded offline while only the query is embedded online.
whenOtherWins: 如果语料只有几百条、延迟不敏感，直接交叉编码全量候选可能更简单且质量更高。
tradeoff: 文档离线预计算 vs 查询在线实时编码
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Docs[Documents] --> Offline[Offline embed]
  Offline --> Index[ANN index]
  Query[Live query] --> Online[Online embed]
  Online --> Index
  Index --> Results[Retrieved docs]
options_en: Re-encode every document on each request.
Use a SQL LIKE full-table scan only.
Pre-enumerate every possible query in advance.
Embed documents offline into an index, and embed the query online.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用向量相似度而不是关键词匹配来找相关文档。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Semantic retrieval finds relevant documents using vector similarity instead of keyword matching.

optionExplanations: 语料只有几百条、延迟不敏感时现算全部文档还行，但文档库一大，每次请求都重算会直接拖垮延迟。
LIKE 全表扫描适合精确关键词命中，但认不出同义或语义相关的表达，语义召回会漏掉大半结果。
查询集合固定且很小时可以提前枚举缓存，但开放搜索的新查询层出不穷，根本枚举不完。
对：文档慢变、查询多变时，把文档离线编码进索引、只让查询在线编码，是语义召回的标准结构。
optionExplanations_en: Recomputing every document on-the-fly is fine only when the corpus is tiny and latency doesn't matter — at real scale it blows the latency budget on every request.
A SQL LIKE scan is fine for exact keyword hits, but it can't recognize synonyms or semantically related phrasing, so semantic recall misses most matches.
Pre-enumerating queries works only for a small, closed query set — an open search surface keeps producing new queries you can't enumerate.
Right: with slow-changing documents and fast-changing queries, embed documents offline into an index and embed only the query online — that's the standard shape for semantic retrieval.

scenario: 两塔模型训练时，一个 batch 里有很多候选可以当负样本。
scenario_en: During two-tower training, each batch contains many candidates that can be used as negatives.
q: InfoNCE 相比 triplet loss 的核心优势是？
q_en: What is InfoNCE's main advantage over triplet loss?
options: 把 batch 内其他候选都当负样本，监督更密集
训练时完全不需要任何正样本对照
这类对比损失只能用来训练图 embedding
能保证每次挑出的负样本都一定是真负样本
why: 决定性是监督密度：InfoNCE 用一个正样本对多个 batch 负样本做分类，比 triplet 更密集。
why_en: InfoNCE gives denser supervision than triplet loss by treating every other candidate in the batch as a negative.
tradeoff: batch 内密集监督 vs 单一 margin 约束
options_en: It treats every other candidate in the batch as a negative, giving denser supervision.
It needs no positive pairs to compare against at all during training.
This contrastive loss can only be used to train graph embeddings.
It guarantees that every negative sampled is always truly negative.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一个正样本和多个负样本当分类问题训练的对比损失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: InfoNCE is a contrastive loss that trains the model to pick the positive out of a batch of positive and negative candidates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让锚点向正样本靠近、离负样本至少差一个 margin 的对比损失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Triplet loss pushes an anchor closer to its positive than to a negative by at least a fixed margin.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次训练迭代里一起处理的一组样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A batch is the group of training examples processed together in one training step.

rows: 稀疏，一条 margin 约束
batch 内其余候选全当负例

optionExplanations: 对：InfoNCE 把同一 batch 里除正样本外的所有候选都当负样本，一步就能拿到远多于 triplet 的对比信号。
对比学习本身就要靠正样本对定义'该靠近谁'，没有正样本模型无从学起。
InfoNCE 是通用的对比学习目标，文本、图像、推荐向量都在用，并不限定图数据。
batch 内的负样本仍可能是没被标注出来的假负例，这一点 InfoNCE 也保证不了。
optionExplanations_en: Right: InfoNCE treats every other candidate in the batch as a negative, giving far denser contrastive signal per step than triplet's single margin.
Contrastive training still needs positive pairs to define what 'should be close,' so this has it backwards.
InfoNCE is a general contrastive objective used for text, image, and recommendation vectors alike — it isn't graph-only.
In-batch negatives can still turn out to be unlabeled false negatives, so InfoNCE offers no such guarantee.

scenario: 两塔模型训练检索用的 embedding，需要负样本教模型分辨相关与不相关候选。
scenario_en: You are training retrieval embeddings for a two-tower model, and negatives teach the model to separate relevant from irrelevant candidates.
q: 训练检索 embedding 时，hard negative 指什么？
q_en: In retrieval embedding training, what is a hard negative?
options: 随机从全库采到的冷门候选
已经被用户点击过的正样本
模型觉得相关但实际标签为负的候选
完全没有任何特征的空样本
why: Hard negative 最能暴露模型边界错误，因为它看起来像好候选但标签为负。只用随机负样本提升有限。
why_en: A hard negative is a candidate the current model thinks is relevant but is actually labeled negative.
options_en: A random, rarely-seen candidate sampled from the whole pool.
A candidate already labeled positive by a user click.
A candidate the current model ranks as relevant but is actually negative.
A blank candidate with no features at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型当前认为相关、但真实标签是负的候选，最能暴露模型边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hard negative is a candidate the current model ranks as relevant that is actually labeled negative.

termDefinitions.meaning: 专门为召回排序训练、让相关查询-候选更靠近的向量表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A retrieval embedding is a vector representation trained so that relevant query-candidate pairs end up close together.

optionExplanations: 随机负样本大多太容易分辨，模型很快就不再从它们身上学到新东西。
被点击过的样本本来就该当正样本拉近，把它当负样本会直接污染标签。
对：hard negative 是模型现在误判成相关、但真实标签是负的候选，正卡在决策边界上。
空样本没有任何特征信号，对梯度更新贡献几乎为零，训练价值很低。
optionExplanations_en: Random negatives are usually too easy to tell apart, so the model quickly stops learning anything new from them.
A clicked item should be pulled closer as a positive; treating it as a negative just corrupts the label.
Right: a hard negative is a candidate the current model mistakenly ranks as relevant even though its true label is negative — it sits right on the decision boundary.
A blank sample carries no feature signal at all, so it contributes almost nothing to the gradient.

scenario: 两塔模型用随机负样本训练后，离线 recall 停滞，线上常召回相似但不合适的内容。
scenario_en: A two-tower model trained with random negatives has stalled offline recall, and online it often retrieves similar but unsuitable content.
q: 下一步最有效的训练改进是什么？
q_en: What training improvement is most useful next?
options: 把 embedding 维度直接降到 8
周期性挖掘 hard negatives 混入训练
删除训练集里所有的正样本
只优化训练集上的准确率指标
why: 随机负样本太弱，模型学不到细粒度区分；定期用模型快照挖 hard negatives 能逼近真实召回错误。
why_en: Periodic hard-negative mining trains the model against the confusing candidates it currently retrieves.
whenOtherWins: 如果模型还没学到基本正负关系，先扩大正样本覆盖和修正标签质量更重要。
tradeoff: 定期挖掘 hard negative 的工程成本 vs 随机负样本的信号强度
options_en: Shrink the embedding dimension straight down to 8.
Periodically mine hard negatives and mix them into training.
Delete every positive sample from the training set.
Optimize only for training-set accuracy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型当前认为相关、但真实标签是负的候选，最能暴露模型边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hard negative is a candidate the current model ranks as relevant that is actually labeled negative.

termDefinitions.meaning: 召回率：真正相关的候选里，有多少被找回来了。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall measures how many of the truly relevant candidates were actually retrieved.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练过程中某一时刻冻结保存的模型版本，用于挖掘负样本等离线任务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A model snapshot is a frozen copy of the model at a point in training, used for offline tasks like negative mining.

optionExplanations: 降维能省成本，但跟'负样本太弱'完全是两回事，改了也治不好 recall 停滞。
对：模型现在只见过好分的随机负样本，学不出精细边界；换成从模型自己容易搞混的候选里定期挖负样本，才能对症下药。
没有正样本，对比训练就失去了'该往哪儿靠'的信号，模型会彻底学不出相似关系。
训练集上的准确率不能反映线上召回是否停滞，盯着这个指标不会改善真实表现。
optionExplanations_en: Shrinking dimension cuts serving cost, but it has nothing to do with weak negatives — it won't fix a stalled recall.
Right: the model has only seen easy random negatives and can't learn a fine boundary; periodically mining the candidates it currently confuses with real ones targets the actual problem.
Without positives, contrastive training loses any signal for what it should pull closer, so the model learns no similarity at all.
Training-set accuracy says nothing about whether online recall has stalled, so optimizing it won't move real performance.

scenario: 社交图里既有已训练过的老节点，也会不断出现全新节点。
scenario_en: A social graph has existing trained nodes, but brand-new nodes keep arriving.
q: transductive 与 inductive 方法的核心区别是？
q_en: What is the key difference between transductive and inductive methods?
options: 前者用 GPU 训练，后者只能用 CPU
前者只能编码文本，后者只能编码图片
前者不需要任何图结构信息
前者只给训练图节点向量，后者学可泛化的函数
why: node2vec 这类 transductive 方法只给训练图节点一张查表；GraphSAGE 这类 inductive 方法学一个函数，可直接嵌入新节点。
why_en: Transductive methods only produce embeddings for nodes seen during training, while inductive methods learn a function that can embed new nodes.
tradeoff: 已训节点的直接查表 vs 新节点的泛化函数
options_en: The former trains on GPU, the latter only on CPU.
The former only encodes text, the latter only encodes images.
The former needs no graph structure at all.
The former only embeds trained nodes, the latter learns a function that generalizes to new nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只学习训练图里已出现节点的向量，新节点没有表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transductive methods only learn embeddings for nodes present in the training graph; new nodes have none.

termDefinitions.meaning: 学一个能根据特征和邻居生成向量的函数，可直接用于新节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Inductive methods learn a function that generates an embedding from a node's features and neighbors, so it works on new nodes too.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用有偏随机游走生成节点序列，再套用 word2vec 式目标训练节点向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: node2vec generates node sequences via biased random walks and trains node vectors with a word2vec-style objective.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种归纳式图神经网络，通过聚合邻居特征为节点生成向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GraphSAGE is an inductive graph neural network that generates a node's embedding by aggregating its neighbors' features.

optionExplanations: 训练用什么硬件只影响成本和速度，不是区分 transductive 和 inductive 的标准。
两类方法都不限定输入模态，文本还是图片是另一个维度的选择。
两类方法都要用到图的边和邻居信息，只是用法不同，不存在完全不用图结构的一类。
对：node2vec 这类方法只给训练图里出现过的节点一张查表向量，GraphSAGE 这类方法学的是能吃新节点特征的函数。
optionExplanations_en: Training hardware only affects cost and speed — it isn't what separates transductive from inductive methods.
Neither family is limited to one input modality; text versus image is a separate design choice.
Both families rely on graph structure like edges and neighbors, just in different ways — neither skips it entirely.
Right: methods like node2vec only hand out a lookup vector for nodes seen during training, while methods like GraphSAGE learn a function that can take a new node's features and neighbors.

scenario: 社交图每天有大量新用户加入，你想把图信号作为下游模型特征。
scenario_en: A social graph gets many new users every day, and you want graph signals as features for downstream models.
q: 更合适的图 embedding 方法是？
q_en: Which graph embedding method fits this case better?
options: GraphSAGE 这类 inductive GNN
只训练一次、之后不再更新的 node2vec
把 user_id 直接做 one-hot
只按粉丝数排序，不训练向量
why: 决定性是每天有大量新用户，inductive GNN 能用特征和邻居在推理时直接生成向量，不必等全图重训。
why_en: An inductive GNN like GraphSAGE can embed new users from their features and neighbors without retraining the whole graph.
whenOtherWins: 如果图几乎不变、只需离线分析已知节点，node2vec/DeepWalk 更简单便宜。
tradeoff: inductive 泛化新节点 vs transductive 更省训练成本
options_en: An inductive GNN such as GraphSAGE.
A node2vec model trained once and never updated.
One-hot encode the user_id directly.
Just sort by follower count, no vectors at all.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种归纳式图神经网络，通过聚合邻居特征为节点生成向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GraphSAGE is an inductive graph neural network that generates a node's embedding by aggregating its neighbors' features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用有偏随机游走生成节点序列，再套用 word2vec 式目标训练节点向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: node2vec generates node sequences via biased random walks and trains node vectors with a word2vec-style objective.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个类别分配独立维度、其余为零的稀疏编码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: One-hot encoding assigns each category its own dimension, with all other dimensions set to zero.

optionExplanations: 对：每天都有新用户涌入时，GraphSAGE 这类 inductive 方法能直接用新节点的特征和邻居现算向量，不用等全图重训。
图几乎不再变化、只分析已知节点时 node2vec 更简单便宜，但这里天天有新用户，它永远给不出新向量。
one-hot 每维只绑定一个用户，新用户依旧没有可共享的结构，也没法用向量做相似度计算。
粉丝数排序完全不看图的邻域关系，一个孤立但粉丝多的账号会被系统性高估。
optionExplanations_en: Right: with new users arriving daily, an inductive method like GraphSAGE can compute a vector on the spot from a new node's features and neighbors, without waiting to retrain the whole graph.
node2vec fits when the graph barely changes and you're only analyzing known nodes, but here it can never produce a vector for the users who show up tomorrow.
One-hot ties each dimension to a single user, so new users still get no shared structure and no vector to compare by similarity.
Sorting by follower count ignores the graph's neighborhood entirely, so an isolated but popular account gets systematically overrated.

scenario: 你要为文本任务训练 embedding，讨论从零训练还是复用预训练模型。
scenario_en: You are training embeddings for a text task and deciding between training from scratch and reusing a pretrained model.
q: 文本 embedding 任务为什么常从预训练 encoder 起步？
q_en: Why do text embedding tasks often start from a pretrained encoder?
options: 预训练模型会自动知道业务标签
从零训练永远比微调更省算力
通用语言结构已学好，只需微调适配领域
预训练模型部署后不用再评估
why: 预训练模型已在大规模语料学到通用语义，微调只需对齐到你的具体任务，省数据和算力。
why_en: A pretrained encoder already captures general language structure, so fine-tuning only needs to adapt it to your task.
options_en: A pretrained model automatically knows your business labels.
Training from scratch is always cheaper than fine-tuning.
General language structure is already learned, so you only fine-tune for the domain.
A pretrained model never needs evaluation after deployment.

termDefinitions.meaning: 已经在大规模通用语料上训练好、可直接复用的编码器。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A pretrained encoder is a model already trained on large general-purpose data that you can reuse as a starting point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在预训练模型基础上，用少量任务数据继续训练以适配具体场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Fine-tuning continues training a pretrained model on a smaller task-specific dataset to adapt it to your use case.

optionExplanations: 业务标签是任务特有的，预训练语料里不会自带，仍要用你的任务数据去对齐。
从零训练需要的数据和算力通常远超微调，这个说法正好说反了。
对：预训练已经在海量语料上学好通用语言结构，微调只需要少量任务数据去适配领域，省下大部分成本。
换到领域数据后效果可能和预训练时不一样，上线后依旧要持续评估。
optionExplanations_en: Business labels are task-specific and don't come bundled with pretraining — you still need your own task data to align them.
Training from scratch usually needs far more data and compute than fine-tuning, so this has it backwards.
Right: pretraining already learned general language structure from huge corpora, so fine-tuning only needs a small amount of task data to adapt it — saving most of the cost.
Performance can shift once you switch to domain data, so you still need to keep evaluating after deployment.

scenario: 企业搜索原型要快速上线，文档是普通英文文本，团队没有海量点击日志。
scenario_en: An enterprise search prototype must ship quickly; documents are ordinary English text, and the team lacks massive click logs.
q: embedding 方案最合理的是？
q_en: Which embedding plan is the most reasonable?
options: 从随机初始化开始训练十亿参数级别的 encoder
先用预训练 sentence-transformer，小数据微调
只用 one-hot 编码的文档 ID 表示文本内容
先直接上线，暂时不做任何检索质量评估
why: 普通英文文本、缺少海量点击日志时，先用预训练文本 embedding 能快速达到可用质量，再用少量数据微调。
why_en: Starting with a pretrained sentence encoder is the pragmatic path when text is ordinary and labeled domain data is limited.
whenOtherWins: 如果领域语言非常特殊且已有海量交互数据，深度微调专用模型可能更值。
tradeoff: 预训练起步 + 小数据微调 vs 从零训练
options_en: Train a billion-parameter-scale encoder starting from random initialization.
Start from a pretrained sentence-transformer, then fine-tune on the small dataset.
Represent the text content only with a one-hot encoded document ID.
Ship straight to production and skip any retrieval quality evaluation for now.

termDefinitions.meaning: 专门为句子/段落生成语义向量的预训练模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sentence-transformer is a pretrained model designed to produce semantic vectors for sentences or passages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个类别分配独立维度、其余为零的稀疏编码。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: One-hot encoding assigns each category its own dimension, with all other dimensions set to zero.

optionExplanations: 领域语言特殊、且已经攒了海量交互数据时，从零训练十亿参数模型才划算，这里数据和算力都不够撑起它。
对：这里文本很普通、点击日志又少，从一个通用句向量模型起步，再拿手头的小数据去微调，是最快达到可用质量的路径。
one-hot 给每篇文档一个孤立维度，新文档不断加入时完全没有语义可共享，检索不到相关内容。
评估可以先做得轻量，但完全跳过会让你根本不知道检索质量是否达标，风险很高。
optionExplanations_en: Training a billion-parameter encoder from scratch pays off once the domain language is unusual and you already have massive interaction data — here neither the data nor the compute is there.
Right: with plain text and few click logs, starting from a general-purpose pretrained embedding model and fine-tuning on the small dataset you have is the fastest path to something usable.
One-hot gives each document an isolated dimension, so as new documents keep arriving there's no shared meaning to retrieve on.
Evaluation can start lightweight, but skipping it entirely means you never know whether retrieval quality is actually good enough — too risky to ship blind.

scenario: 你的团队已经训练出高质量的商品 embedding，讨论它能用在哪些地方。
scenario_en: Your team has trained high-quality product embeddings and is discussing where they can be used.
q: 以下哪些是 embedding 在系统中的常见用法？（多选）
q_en: Which uses of embeddings are common in systems? (multi-select)
options: 作为下游模型的紧凑特征
完全替代所有线上监控指标
按向量距离做聚类或去重
做 ANN 检索召回的索引 key
why: embedding 可作特征、聚类空间和检索 key 三种常见用途，但不能替代数据质量或线上监控。
why_en: Embeddings commonly serve as model features, a clustering space, and retrieval keys, but they never replace monitoring.
options_en: Use it as a compact feature for a downstream model.
Let it fully replace all online monitoring metrics.
Cluster or de-duplicate items by vector distance.
Use it as the index key for ANN retrieval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在向量索引里快速找到与查询最接近的候选集合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN retrieval quickly finds the set of candidates closest to a query vector inside a vector index.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把相似样本按距离分组，常用 k-means 等算法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Clustering groups similar samples by distance, often using an algorithm like k-means.

optionExplanations: 把 embedding 当特征喂给排序或分类模型，能省掉大量手工特征工程，还能迁移到新任务。
这把 embedding 和系统监控搞混了——延迟、错误率、业务转化这些健康信号，向量表示不到，误信会让故障被漏掉。
距离相近的向量能直接拿来做用户分群、话题聚类或近重复检测，不用额外训练分类器。
把候选向量放进 ANN 索引当检索 key，是推荐、搜索、RAG 召回链路的基础用法。
optionExplanations_en: Feeding an embedding into a ranker or classifier as a compact feature saves a lot of manual feature engineering and transfers to new tasks.
This confuses an embedding with system monitoring — vectors say nothing about latency, error rate, or conversion, so believing this lets real outages slip past unnoticed.
Vectors that sit close in distance can be used directly for user segmentation, topic clustering, or near-duplicate detection without training a separate classifier.
Loading candidate vectors into an ANN index as the retrieval key is the basic building block behind recommendation, search, and RAG retrieval.

scenario: RAG 系统回答不相关，prompt 已经调过，但检索 top-k 经常漏掉同义概念。
scenario_en: A RAG system gives irrelevant answers; the prompt has been tuned, but top-k retrieval often misses synonym concepts.
q: 最优先排查的是？
q_en: What should you debug first?
options: LLM 最终输出结果在页面上用的字体大小
数据库里存这张表用的表名字符串是否足够短
前端展示页面是否启用了深色模式主题
文档与查询 embedding 能否表达同义关系
why: RAG 质量强依赖检索：embedding 不懂领域同义词，prompt 补不回缺失上下文。先修检索，再修生成。
why_en: RAG failures often start with embeddings that cannot retrieve semantically related documents, which prompt tuning cannot fix.
whenOtherWins: 如果检索命中文档正确但答案仍乱编，生成模型或上下文拼接才是主要问题。
tradeoff: 先修检索质量 vs 先调 prompt
options_en: The font size used to display the LLM's final output on the page.
Whether the table name string stored for this database table is short enough.
Whether the front-end display page has a dark mode theme enabled.
Whether document and query embeddings capture domain synonym relationships.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索增强生成：先检索相关文档，再让 LLM 基于它们回答。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RAG, retrieval-augmented generation, retrieves relevant documents first and then has the LLM answer using them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索返回的前 k 个最相关候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-k means the k most relevant candidates returned by a retrieval search.

optionExplanations: 字体大小只影响展示效果，跟检索能不能找到相关文档完全无关。
表名长短是给人读的可维护性问题，不会改变 query 和文档之间的向量距离。
深色模式是纯前端偏好设置，跟 RAG 检索链路挨不上边。
对：prompt 已经调过还漏同义概念，说明是 embedding 认不出领域同义词，该先修检索而不是继续调 prompt。
optionExplanations_en: Font size only affects how the answer is displayed and has nothing to do with whether retrieval finds the right documents.
Table name length is a readability concern for humans; it doesn't change the vector distance between a query and a document.
Dark mode is a pure front-end preference and has nothing to do with the RAG retrieval path.
Right: if prompt tuning is already done and synonyms are still missed, the embedding doesn't recognize the domain synonym — fix retrieval before touching the prompt again.

scenario: 面试官告诉你：多数生产 embedding 维度落在 64-1024，128-512 最常见。
scenario_en: The interviewer states that most production embedding dimensions fall around 64-1024, with 128-512 most common.
q: 这个量级最支持哪个设计判断？
q_en: What design judgment does this order of magnitude support?
options: 维度是成本-质量旋钮，可按需调整
维度必须精确等于业务类别数量
维度越高，成本必然可以忽略不计
维度够大就不用再做效果评估
why: 64-1024 是常见区间，128-512 是甜点：维度是成本和质量的可调旋钮，不是越大越好的固定数字。
why_en: The 64-to-1024 range shows dimension is a tunable cost-quality knob, not a number you memorize or maximize blindly.
options_en: Dimension is a tunable cost-quality knob you adjust to fit the workload.
Dimension must exactly equal the number of business categories.
Higher dimension always makes cost negligible.
A large enough dimension means you can skip evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 向量的长度，决定表达力与训练/检索成本的权衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding dimension is the length of the vector, trading off representational power against training and search cost.

optionExplanations: 对：常见区间落在 64-1024、甜点在 128-512，说明维度是可以按场景调的成本质量旋钮，不是必须拉满的固定值。
维度是训练时选定的超参数，不需要跟业务类别数一一对应，二者是不同的概念。
维度越大，存储、训练和检索的算力开销都会跟着涨，成本不会自动消失。
维度选大只是给了更强的表达力，效果仍要靠 recall@k 之类的下游指标验证，不能省掉评估。
optionExplanations_en: Right: the common range runs 64 to 1024 with a sweet spot around 128-512, which shows dimension is a cost-quality knob you tune per workload, not a value you max out.
Dimension is a hyperparameter you choose at training time; it has no reason to match the number of business categories.
Bigger dimensions raise storage, training, and search cost together — the cost doesn't just disappear.
A larger dimension only adds capacity; you still need downstream metrics like recall@k to confirm quality, not skip evaluation.

scenario: 短视频首页召回 QPS 极高，候选库巨大，召回阶段延迟预算很紧。
scenario_en: A short-video home feed has very high retrieval QPS, a huge candidate pool, and a tight latency budget.
q: embedding 维度应该偏向哪种选择？
q_en: Which embedding dimension choice should you lean toward?
options: 1024+ 的大维度，不考虑成本
维度和用户数量保持一致
64-256 的小/中维度，先权衡吞吐和成本
每次请求都随机改变向量维度
why: 召回面对亿级向量和高 QPS，成本敏感；64-256 的小/中维度常能给出足够的粗召回质量。
why_en: High-QPS retrieval over huge candidate pools usually starts with a compact 64-to-256 dimensional embedding because serving cost dominates.
whenOtherWins: 如果是低 QPS、高价值的重排或离线分析，更大维度更可能赢。
tradeoff: 小维度换吞吐和成本 vs 大维度换表达力
options_en: A large 1024+ dimension, ignoring cost.
Keep the dimension equal to the number of users.
A small-to-medium 64-256 dimension, weighing throughput and cost first.
Randomly change the vector dimension on every request.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒查询数，衡量系统承受的请求速率。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS, queries per second, measures how many requests a system handles each second.

termDefinitions.meaning: 向量的长度，决定表达力与训练/检索成本的权衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding dimension is the length of the vector, trading off representational power against training and search cost.

optionExplanations: 低 QPS、高价值的重排或离线分析场景才值得上大维度，这里亿级候选加高 QPS，成本会直接爆掉。
维度决定的是向量表达力，跟用户行数没有必然关系，让维度跟用户数走只会失控膨胀。
对：亿级候选、高 QPS 又要压延迟时，64-256 的小/中维度通常已经够粗召回用，还能把检索成本压住。
ANN 索引要求同一空间里所有向量维度一致，随请求改变维度会让近邻搜索直接失效。
optionExplanations_en: A large 1024+ dimension pays off for low-QPS, high-value reranking or offline analysis — here billions of candidates plus high QPS would blow the cost budget.
Dimension controls a vector's expressive power, not how many rows exist; tying it to user count would make it balloon out of control.
Right: with billion-scale candidates and high QPS under a tight latency budget, a compact 64-256 dimension usually gives enough coarse-retrieval quality while keeping search cost down.
An ANN index requires every vector in the same space to share one fixed dimension; changing it per request breaks nearest-neighbor search outright.

scenario: 召回既要快速粗筛候选，又想在精排阶段保留高质量向量。
scenario_en: Retrieval needs fast coarse filtering, while reranking should still use a higher-quality vector.
q: Matryoshka embedding 的用途是什么？
q_en: What is Matryoshka embedding used for?
options: 把所有向量都统一压缩成 one-hot 编码
同一向量的前缀维度本身也是有效 embedding
让 ANN 检索完全不需要建立索引结构
自动帮所有新实体消除掉冷启动问题
why: Matryoshka 训练让前 64、128、256 维等前缀都能独立当向量用，小前缀粗召回、完整向量再重排。
why_en: Matryoshka embeddings let smaller prefixes of the same vector work on their own for fast coarse retrieval before full-vector reranking.
options_en: Compress every single vector down into a uniform one-hot encoding.
A prefix of the same vector is also a valid, usable embedding.
Make ANN retrieval work without ever building an index structure.
Automatically eliminate the cold-start problem for every new entity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时让向量的前缀（如前 64/128 维）也单独有效的技巧。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Matryoshka embedding is trained so that its prefixes, like the first 64 or 128 dimensions, are also valid embeddings on their own.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻搜索，在向量索引里快速找出最接近的候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN, approximate nearest neighbor search, quickly finds the closest candidates inside a vector index.

optionExplanations: one-hot 是稀疏、每维孤立的编码，跟 Matryoshka 想让稠密向量前缀可用的目标正好相反。
对：训练时特意让前 64、128 维这类前缀单独可用，检索时可以先用短前缀粗筛，再用完整向量重排。
ANN 依旧要建索引结构才能做近邻搜索，Matryoshka 改变的是可用的向量维度前缀，不是索引本身。
冷启动缺的是行为或内容信号，Matryoshka 只是维度上的训练技巧，解决不了新实体没数据的问题。
optionExplanations_en: One-hot is sparse with every dimension isolated — the opposite of what Matryoshka does, which keeps a dense vector's prefix usable.
Right: training deliberately makes prefixes like the first 64 or 128 dimensions usable on their own, so retrieval can filter with a short prefix first and rerank with the full vector.
ANN still needs an index structure to search efficiently; Matryoshka only changes which vector prefixes are usable, not the indexing itself.
Cold start is missing behavior or content signal, and Matryoshka is just a dimension-training trick — it can't manufacture data for a brand-new entity.

scenario: 你训练完 embedding，面试官问怎么评估质量。
scenario_en: You have trained embeddings, and the interviewer asks how you would evaluate their quality.
q: intrinsic 和 extrinsic 评估的主要区别是？
q_en: What is the main difference between intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation?
options: 前者只能线上跑，后者只能离线跑
前者用于 SQL 查询，后者用于 Redis 缓存
前者不需要任何数据就能评估
前者看向量空间本身，后者看下游任务效果
why: Intrinsic 看向量空间本身（邻居、相似词）；extrinsic 看下游任务效果（recall@k、线上转化）。面试主指标应锚定 extrinsic。
why_en: Intrinsic evaluation inspects the embedding space itself, while extrinsic evaluation measures performance on the downstream task.
tradeoff: 向量空间自身结构 vs 下游任务真实效果
options_en: Intrinsic can only run online, extrinsic only offline.
Intrinsic is for SQL queries, extrinsic is for Redis caching.
Intrinsic needs no data at all to evaluate.
Intrinsic inspects the vector space itself; extrinsic measures downstream task performance.

termDefinitions.meaning: 直接检查向量空间本身的性质，比如近邻是否合理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Intrinsic evaluation directly inspects properties of the embedding space itself, such as whether nearest neighbors look sensible.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用下游任务的真实效果衡量 embedding 好坏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Extrinsic evaluation measures embedding quality by performance on the actual downstream task.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量排序结果质量的指标，位置越靠前权重越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG is a ranking-quality metric that weights correctly ranked results more heavily near the top of the list.

optionExplanations: 在线离线是执行环境的选择，跟 intrinsic/extrinsic 的定义没有关系，两者都可以离线做。
SQL 和 Redis 是存储技术，跟评估 embedding 质量是两个完全不同的话题。
两类评估都要靠数据才能下结论，intrinsic 也需要样本去检查近邻是否合理。
对：intrinsic 直接看向量空间本身的几何结构，extrinsic 看它在下游任务上的真实表现，面试该把主指标锚在后者。
optionExplanations_en: Online versus offline is an execution choice, unrelated to the intrinsic/extrinsic definition — both can be run offline.
SQL and Redis are storage technologies, a completely different topic from evaluating embedding quality.
Both types of evaluation need data to draw conclusions; intrinsic checks still require samples to see if neighbors look sensible.
Right: intrinsic looks directly at the geometry of the vector space, while extrinsic measures real performance on the downstream task — anchor the headline metric on the latter.

scenario: 你训练了商品 embedding 用于召回，面试官问怎么评估。
scenario_en: You trained product embeddings for retrieval, and the interviewer asks how to evaluate them.
q: 最该作为主评估指标的是？
q_en: What should be the primary evaluation metric?
options: held-out 数据上的 Recall@K 或 NDCG
只看训练阶段做的二维可视化投影效果好不好看
只汇报模型训练阶段收敛时候的 loss 数值走势变化
只问身边同事对结果的主观感觉，然后打个分数
why: 召回 embedding 的价值在能否找回相关候选，held-out 上的 recall@k / NDCG 最贴近这一点。
why_en: Retrieval embeddings should be evaluated mainly by recall or ranking metrics on held-out query-item pairs.
whenOtherWins: 早期训练调试时，邻居检查和向量分布 sanity check 更快，可作辅助。
tradeoff: 下游检索指标 vs 训练期代理指标
options_en: Recall@K or NDCG on held-out data.
Only whether the 2D visualization projection made during training looks nice.
Only report how the training loss value trends as it converges during training.
Only ask a nearby coworker for their subjective impression, then give it a score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时完全没用过、专门留来测试的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Held-out data is data kept aside and never used during training, reserved for testing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索返回的前 K 个结果中，命中真正相关项的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall@K measures the fraction of truly relevant items found within the top K retrieved results.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量排序结果质量的指标，位置越靠前权重越高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG is a ranking-quality metric that weights correctly ranked results more heavily near the top of the list.

optionExplanations: 对：召回是否有用，看的是能不能把该找的候选真正找回来；held-out 集上的 recall@k 或 NDCG 最贴近这个目标。
早期训练调试时看投影能快速做个 sanity check，但投影好看不等于线上召回效果好，不能当主指标。
loss 只反映模型在训练集上拟合得好不好，跟能不能召回相关候选是两回事，低 loss 不保证高 recall。
主观打分能收集一些反馈，但没法量化也没法在不同版本之间稳定比较，不适合当主指标。
optionExplanations_en: Right: retrieval's whole value is whether it finds the relevant candidates, and recall@k or NDCG on held-out data measures exactly that.
A 2D projection is a quick sanity check during early debugging, but a nice-looking plot doesn't mean retrieval actually works well online — not a real metric.
Loss only reflects how well the model fits the training data, not whether it retrieves the right candidates — low loss doesn't guarantee high recall.
Subjective scoring can gather some feedback, but it can't be quantified or compared reliably across iterations, so it's a poor primary metric.

scenario: 推荐系统的候选库很大，检索延迟预算很紧。
scenario_en: A recommender has a huge candidate pool and a tight retrieval latency budget.
q: 候选侧 embedding 生产环境通常怎么 serving？
q_en: How are candidate-side embeddings usually served in production?
options: 每次请求都现算全部候选库
只存进浏览器 localStorage
批量预计算后加载进 ANN 索引
只写进日志，从不参与查询
why: 候选库大且相对稳定，离线批量编码入 ANN 索引是低延迟检索的前提；在线只算请求侧向量。
why_en: Candidate embeddings are usually batch-computed offline and loaded into an ANN index so online serving only embeds the request.
options_en: Recompute the entire candidate pool on every request.
Store them only in the browser's localStorage.
Batch-precompute them and load them into an ANN index.
Only write them to logs and never query them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持快速近邻搜索的向量索引结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ANN index is a vector index structure built to support fast nearest-neighbor search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 离线一次性算好大量向量，再加载供在线查询使用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Batch precomputing means computing a large set of vectors offline once, then loading them for online queries.

optionExplanations: 候选库到亿级时，每次请求都现算一遍会直接让延迟失控，扛不住高 QPS。
localStorage 是单个浏览器的本地存储，服务不到所有用户和设备的检索请求。
对：候选量大但相对稳定，离线批量算好向量再灌进 ANN 索引，线上只需算请求侧向量加一次近邻查询。
写进日志但不接入查询链路，这份向量根本没被检索用上，等于白算。
optionExplanations_en: Once the candidate pool reaches billions, recomputing it on every request sends latency out of control under real QPS.
localStorage is local to one browser and can't serve retrieval requests from every user and device.

Right: with a large but fairly stable candidate pool, precompute vectors offline in batch and load them into an ANN index, so online cost is just embedding the request plus one nearest-neighbor lookup.
Writing vectors to logs without wiring them into the query path means they never actually get used for retrieval.

scenario: 生产系统里的 embedding 已经三个月没有重新计算过。
scenario_en: Production embeddings have not been recomputed for three months.
q: embedding 长期不刷新最常见的后果是什么？
q_en: What is the common consequence of leaving embeddings stale?
options: ANN 查询会自动变成强一致事务
召回仍按旧兴趣/旧内容工作，结果滞后
模型从此不再需要冷启动策略
向量维度会随时间自动变小
why: 物品和用户状态都会变化，旧 embedding 让推荐/搜索按过时兴趣或内容工作。常见缓解是定期批量加事件驱动刷新。
why_en: Stale embeddings make retrieval keep reflecting old user behavior or old item content.
options_en: ANN queries automatically become strongly consistent transactions.
Retrieval keeps working off stale interests or stale content.
The model no longer needs a cold-start strategy.
Vector dimension automatically shrinks over time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 重新计算并替换旧的 embedding，让它反映最新状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Refreshing recomputes and replaces an old embedding so it reflects the entity's current state.

optionExplanations: 强一致性是数据库层面的语义保证，ANN 检索不会因为向量老旧而自动获得这个属性。
对：用户兴趣和物品内容都在变，向量三个月没更新，召回就一直按旧状态工作，结果自然会滞后于现实。
冷启动是新实体缺历史数据的独立问题，不刷新旧向量不会让这个问题自动消失。
维度是训练时固定的超参数，不会因为时间流逝而自己收缩，只有重新训练才会改变。
optionExplanations_en: Strong consistency is a database-level guarantee — ANN retrieval doesn't automatically gain it just because vectors are old.
Right: both user interests and item content keep changing, so a vector left unrefreshed for three months keeps retrieval working off stale state, lagging behind reality.
Cold start is the separate problem of new entities lacking history; not refreshing old vectors doesn't make that problem disappear.
Dimension is a fixed training-time hyperparameter — it doesn't shrink on its own with the passage of time, only retraining changes it.

scenario: 新闻推荐要求几分钟内适应用户刚点击的突发事件，夜间批量刷新太慢。
scenario_en: News recommendations must adapt to a user's breaking-news click within minutes; nightly batch refresh is too slow.
q: 更合适的更新策略是？
q_en: Which update strategy fits better?
options: 每季度做一次全量重训
完全不使用任何用户行为信号
把向量维度直接加到 4096
近实时更新用户 embedding
why: 高新鲜度场景要把最近交互快速写入用户表示，常见做法是近实时更新 embedding 或参数服务器。
why_en: Minute-level personalization needs near-real-time embedding updates instead of relying only on nightly batch refresh.
whenOtherWins: 如果兴趣变化慢、延迟不敏感，批量刷新更简单可靠。
tradeoff: 近实时更新的工程复杂度 vs 批量刷新的简单稳定
options_en: Do one full retrain every quarter.
Use no user behavior signal at all.
Just push the vector dimension up to 4096.
Update user embeddings in near real-time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 专门存放和近实时更新大规模 embedding 表的服务组件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A parameter server is a service component that stores and updates large embedding tables in near real time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 事件发生后很短延迟（秒到分钟级）就反映到系统状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Near real-time means system state reflects an event within a short delay, on the order of seconds to minutes.

optionExplanations: 兴趣变化慢、延迟不敏感时季度重训足够简单可靠，但突发新闻要分钟级反应，季度周期完全跟不上。
彻底不用行为信号等于放弃个性化，跟新闻推荐要跟上用户刚点击兴趣的目标背道而驰。
加大维度只是提升表达力，不会让用户状态更新得更快，解决不了新鲜度延迟的问题。
对：要在几分钟内跟上用户刚点的突发事件，得把最近交互近实时写进用户表示或参数服务器，而不是等批量刷新。
optionExplanations_en: Quarterly retraining is simple and reliable when interests barely change and latency doesn't matter, but a breaking-news click needs a minute-level response, far faster than a quarter.
Dropping behavior signal entirely means abandoning personalization, which works against a news feed that's supposed to track what a user just clicked.
A bigger dimension only adds representational capacity; it doesn't make the user's state update any faster, so it doesn't fix the freshness lag.

Right: to catch up with a user's just-clicked breaking event within minutes, recent interactions need to be written near-real-time into the user representation or a parameter server, instead of waiting for a batch refresh.

scenario: 推荐系统里，新用户和新物品还没有任何互动记录。
scenario_en: In a recommender, new users and items have no interaction records yet.
q: 行为 embedding 遇到新用户/新物品的主要问题是？
q_en: What is the main cold-start issue for behavioral embeddings?
options: 没有交互历史，行为向量缺足够信号
向量数值无法存进磁盘文件
模型架构无法输出浮点数
ANN 索引不支持新增节点
why: 行为训练依赖历史互动，新用户/新物品一开始缺这些数据，行为向量没有足够信号。
why_en: Behavioral embeddings struggle at cold start because new entities have no interaction history yet.
options_en: There is no interaction history, so the behavioral vector lacks enough signal.
The vector values cannot be saved to disk files.
The model architecture cannot output floating-point numbers.
The ANN index does not support adding new nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户或新物品因为缺少历史数据而难以被有效推荐或表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is when a new user or item is hard to recommend or represent because it has no historical data yet.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从用户点击、观看等历史互动学出的向量表示。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A behavioral embedding is a vector representation learned from historical interactions like clicks or watches.

optionExplanations: 对：行为向量是从历史点击、观看这类互动里学出来的，新用户新物品一开始压根没有这些数据可学。
向量本质就是一组浮点数，写进磁盘是基本的存储能力，不是新实体场景的真实障碍。
神经网络输出浮点向量是最基本的能力，问题从来不是架构，而是没有行为数据可学。
主流 ANN 索引都支持增量插入新向量，插入能力解决的是上线问题，不解决初始表示质量差的问题。
optionExplanations_en: Right: a behavioral vector is learned from history like clicks or watches, and a new user or item simply has none of that data yet to learn from.
A vector is just a set of floats, and writing it to disk is basic storage capability — not a real obstacle for new entities.
Outputting a float vector is the most basic thing a neural network does; the real issue is never architecture, it's missing behavior data to learn from.
Mainstream ANN indexes support inserting new vectors incrementally — insertion solves the serving problem, not the poor quality of the initial representation.

scenario: 新视频刚上传，0 次观看，但推荐系统仍要给它有限曝光。
scenario_en: A new video has just been uploaded with zero views, but the recommender still needs to give it limited exposure.
q: 最合理的初始表示是什么？
q_en: What is the most reasonable initial representation?
options: 先等它自然积累出足够多观看量后再处理
随机给它分配一个热门视频用过的向量
用标题、缩略图、作者等内容生成 embedding
把它永远固定排在推荐列表的最末位置
why: 新视频没有行为信号，只能先靠标题、缩略图、作者等内容特征估计受众，再用探索流量逐步混入行为信号。
why_en: A cold-start video should begin with a content and metadata embedding, then blend in behavioral signals as they arrive.
whenOtherWins: 如果平台明确只推荐成熟库存，等待行为数据更安全，但会牺牲新创作者成长。
tradeoff: 立即可得的内容特征 vs 更慢积累的行为信号
diagram:
flowchart LR
  New[New entity] --> NoHist[No behavior history]
  New --> Content[Content metadata]
  Content --> Initial[Initial embedding]
  Interactions[New interactions] --> Blend[Blend behavior]
  Initial --> Blend
options_en: Wait until it naturally accumulates enough views before doing anything.
Randomly assign it a vector that a popular video has already used.
Generate an embedding from title, thumbnail, and author metadata.
Permanently pin it at the very bottom of the recommendation list forever.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从标题、缩略图、文本等属性生成的向量，无需互动数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A content embedding is generated from attributes like title, thumbnail, or text, and needs no interaction data.

optionExplanations: 只推荐成熟库存、宁可牺牲新内容成长时等待更安全，但这里还要求给新视频有限曝光，等待就永远等不到。
借一个热门视频的向量会让系统把冷门内容误当成爆款推，反而误导后续的行为信号收集。
对：零观看时标题、缩略图、作者这些内容特征立刻就能拿到，先靠它们估计受众，再用探索流量慢慢混入行为信号。
永久垫底等于直接放弃这条内容的冷启动机会，跟仍要给它有限曝光的要求正好相反。
optionExplanations_en: Waiting is the safer call when a platform only recommends mature inventory and is fine sacrificing new-content growth — but here the video still needs some exposure now, and waiting never delivers that.
Borrowing a popular video's vector makes the system misread cold content as a hit, which then corrupts whatever behavior signal gets collected next.
Right: with zero views, title, thumbnail, and author are available immediately, so use them to estimate the audience first, then blend in behavior signal as exploration traffic arrives.
Permanently ranking it last is giving up on this content's cold start entirely, the opposite of the requirement to still give it some exposure.

scenario: 系统要在毫秒级从大规模候选库里检索最相关结果。
scenario_en: The system needs to retrieve the most relevant results from a large candidate pool within milliseconds.
q: 按正确顺序排列 embedding 检索 serving 流程。
q_en: Put the embedding retrieval serving flow in the right order.
why: 候选侧预计算是规模化关键；在线路径只做请求编码、近邻检索和下游处理，把重计算放到离线。
why_en: Retrieval scales by precomputing candidate vectors offline, embedding the request online, searching the ANN index, then handing results downstream.
whenOtherWins: 如果候选库很小、延迟不敏感，在线全量编码和精排会更简单。
tradeoff: 候选离线预计算 vs 请求在线实时编码
steps: 离线编码候选并构建 ANN 索引
用 ANN 找 top-k 近邻
把候选交给 ranker 或生成器下游处理
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Encode candidates] --> B[Build ANN]
  B --> C[Embed request]
  C --> D[Search top K]
  D --> E[Rank or generate]

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持快速近邻搜索的向量索引结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ANN index is a vector index structure built to support fast nearest-neighbor search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在线把用户请求或查询实时编码成的向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A query embedding is the vector produced by encoding the user's request or query online, in real time.

scenario: 你在训练两塔召回模型，需要让 loss 把 query 和 candidate 向量对齐到同一空间。
scenario_en: You are training a two-tower retrieval model and need the loss to align query and candidate vectors in one space.
q: 按正确顺序排列两塔 contrastive 训练流程。
q_en: Put the two-tower contrastive training flow in the right order.
why: 训练先定义正负关系，再编码两侧、算相似度，最后用 loss 调整空间，负样本质量决定边界学得多细。
why_en: Two-tower contrastive training collects pairs, encodes both sides, scores similarity, and updates the towers to separate positives from negatives.
whenOtherWins: 如果候选数量很小且质量优先，交叉编码器可直接联合看 query 和 candidate。
tradeoff: 双塔预计算效率 vs 交叉编码质量
steps: 计算 batch 内所有 query-candidate 相似度
收集正样本对并采样负样本
更新两个塔让正样本更近、负样本更远
分别编码 query/user 和 candidate/item
diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[Positive pairs] --> E[Encode both sides]
  N[Negatives] --> E
  E --> S[Similarity matrix]
  S --> L[Contrastive loss]
  L --> U[Update towers]

termDefinitions.meaning: 用两个独立编码器分别编码查询和候选，输出到同一向量空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A two-tower model uses two separate encoders, one for the query and one for the candidate, that output into the same vector space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 拉近正样本、推远负样本的训练目标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A contrastive loss trains the model to pull positive pairs closer together and push negative pairs farther apart.

scenario: 你要在面试白板上说明两塔召回分数如何从向量得到。
scenario_en: You need to explain on a whiteboard how a two-tower retrieval score is computed from vectors.
q: 这段代码最准确表达了哪种线上打分？
q_en: What online scoring pattern does this code represent?
codeSample:
score = dot(query_embedding, item_embedding)
top_k = ann_index.search(query_embedding, k=100)
options: 用候选发布时间作为唯一排序分数
用查询向量与候选向量的点积/近邻距离打分
用数据库自增 ID 排序
把训练 loss 直接当线上分数用
why: 两塔训练让同空间向量的点积代表匹配度；代码用点积算分、ANN 做近邻搜索，这是召回分，不是最终精排。
why_en: Two-tower retrieval scores candidates by vector similarity, typically dot product plus ANN search for the top-k lookup.
whenOtherWins: 如果需要精细理解 query 和候选的逐 token 交互，交叉编码 ranker 会赢但成本更高。
tradeoff: 向量相似度召回分 vs 精细逐 token 交互打分
options_en: Rank candidates only by their publish timestamp.
Score candidates by the dot product or nearest-neighbor distance between query and candidate vectors.
Sort candidates by database auto-increment ID.
Use the training loss value directly as the online score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个向量对应元素相乘再求和，常用来打相似度分数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dot product multiplies two vectors element-wise and sums the results, commonly used as a similarity score.

termDefinitions.meaning: 支持快速近邻搜索的向量索引结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ANN index is a vector index structure built to support fast nearest-neighbor search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索返回的前 k 个最相关候选。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: top_k refers to the k most relevant candidates returned by a search.

optionExplanations: 按发布时间排序适合新鲜度召回，但这段代码里根本没有时间字段，跟这段打分逻辑对不上。
对：两塔训练让同一空间里的点积代表匹配度，这段代码正是用 dot 算分、再让 ANN 做近邻搜索，是标准的召回打分方式。
自增 ID 只是存储时分配的顺序号，跟 query 和候选是否匹配没有任何语义关系。
loss 是训练时用来更新参数的中间量，从来不是拿来给线上候选排序的分数。
optionExplanations_en: Sorting by publish time fits freshness ranking, but this code has no time field at all — it doesn't match this scoring logic.
Right: two-tower training makes the dot product in a shared space represent match quality, and this code scores with dot product then searches ANN for neighbors — that's the standard retrieval score.
An auto-increment ID is just a storage-assigned order number, with no semantic relationship to whether a query matches a candidate.
Loss is the intermediate value used to update parameters during training, never a score used to rank candidates online.

q: 在 embedding 面试回答中，哪些点能显示生产经验？（多选）
q_en: Which points show production experience in an embedding interview? (multi-select)
options: 说明训练目标和使用的 loss
说明负样本采样策略
只说“语义很强”，不解释服务方式
说明维度选择背后的成本权衡
why: 高级回答会覆盖训练目标、负采样和维度权衡，而不是停在“向量能理解语义”这种空泛断言。
why_en: A production-grade embedding answer names the training objective, negative-sampling strategy, and dimension tradeoff.
options_en: Name the training objective and the loss used.
Explain the negative-sampling strategy.
Just say 'the semantics are strong' without explaining serving.
Explain the cost tradeoff behind the dimension choice.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为对比训练挑选“不相关”候选的策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Negative sampling is the strategy for choosing 'not relevant' candidates used in contrastive training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时用来衡量预测好坏、指导参数更新的目标函数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Loss is the objective function that measures prediction quality and drives parameter updates during training.

optionExplanations: 讲清训练目标和 loss，能让面试官看出你知道'相似'这个词在你的系统里具体指什么。
说明负样本怎么采，能证明你想过模型能学到多细的决策边界，而不是随便丢一批负例。
只说'语义很强'是空洞断言，落不到训练、评估或 serving 的任何具体细节，面试官听不出真实经验。
讲维度选择背后的权衡，能体现你考虑过线上检索的延迟和存储成本，不是只盯着模型质量。
optionExplanations_en: Naming the training objective and loss lets the interviewer see you know exactly what 'similar' means in your system.
Explaining the negative-sampling strategy shows you thought about how fine a decision boundary the model can learn, not just tossed in random negatives.
Saying 'the semantics are strong' is an empty claim that touches nothing about training, evaluation, or serving — it signals no real experience.
Explaining the tradeoff behind the dimension choice shows you weighed online latency and storage cost, not just model quality.

scenario: 内容审核团队想直接复用推荐团队训练好的 embedding。
scenario_en: A content moderation team wants to directly reuse embeddings trained by the recommendation team.
q: 推荐 embedding 直接挪给内容审核用，最大风险是？
q_en: What is the biggest risk of reusing recommendation embeddings for moderation?
options: embedding 完全不能作为特征输入
审核模型会自动变成无监督模型
所有向量维度都自带人工标签
训练目标可能和审核风险不一致
why: 推荐 embedding 表示的是原训练目标学到的结构，可能编码“会互动”而非“是否违规”，需验证下游收益和偏差。
why_en: Shared embeddings carry the structure of their original training objective, which may not align with a new downstream task.
options_en: Embeddings can never be used as an input feature.
The moderation model automatically becomes unsupervised.
Every dimension comes with a human-readable label.
The original training objective may not align with moderation risk.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判断内容是否违规、需要处理的系统。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Content moderation is the system that judges whether content violates policy and needs action.

optionExplanations: 跨团队把 embedding 当特征复用是很常见的做法，这个说法直接否定了迁移的价值。
换个下游任务不会自动改变模型的监督方式，监督方式取决于新任务本身怎么设计。
embedding 的维度通常没有人工可读的含义，需要额外分析才能解释每一维大致代表什么。
对：推荐 embedding 学的是'会不会互动'，不等于'是否违规'，直接套用可能漏检或误伤，要先验证下游效果。
optionExplanations_en: Reusing embeddings as features across teams is common practice, so this claim directly denies their transfer value.
Switching to a new downstream task doesn't automatically change the model's supervision style — that depends on how the new task itself is set up.
Embedding dimensions usually carry no human-readable meaning; you'd need extra analysis just to guess what each one roughly represents.
Right: a recommendation embedding learns 'will this get engagement,' not 'is this a violation' — reusing it directly risks misses or false flags, so validate downstream performance first.

scenario: 平台需要找出内容库里高度相似的重复内容。
scenario_en: The platform needs to find highly similar duplicate content in a large content library.
q: 有了好 embedding 后，近重复检测通常怎么做？
q_en: With good embeddings, how do you usually detect near duplicates?
options: 按向量距离阈值找邻近样本
只比较原始字符串长度
随机抽样，全靠人工肉眼看
按主键做哈希取模分组
why: embedding 把语义或行为相似的实体放得近，近重复可以用距离阈值系统性发现；阈值要按误报/漏报权衡调。
why_en: Near-duplicate detection typically uses a distance threshold inside a good embedding space.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  Item[Item embedding] --> ANN[Nearest neighbors]
  ANN --> Dist[Distance threshold]
  Dist --> Dup[Near duplicate set]
  Dup --> Review[Tune FP FN]
options_en: Find neighboring samples using a vector-distance threshold.
Compare only the raw string length.
Randomly sample and eyeball every pair manually.
Group items by hashing and modding the primary key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 内容高度相似但不完全相同的一对样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A near-duplicate is a pair of samples that are highly similar but not exactly identical.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判断两个向量是否“足够近”的截断值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A distance threshold is the cutoff value used to decide whether two vectors are 'close enough' to count as similar.

optionExplanations: 对：语义或行为相近的实体在向量空间里离得近，设一个距离阈值就能系统性地把近重复筛出来。
字符串长度跟内容是否相似基本无关，两段等长的文本完全可能毫不相关。
人工抽样肉眼看可以用来校准阈值，但覆盖不了大规模内容库，会漏掉绝大多数重复对。
哈希取模只是把数据分到不同桶里做分片，同一个桶里的内容不一定相似，不同桶的也可能是重复内容。
optionExplanations_en: Right: entities that are semantically or behaviorally similar end up close in vector space, so a distance threshold can systematically surface near-duplicates.
String length has almost nothing to do with content similarity — two passages of the same length can be completely unrelated.
Manual eyeballing on a random sample can help calibrate a threshold, but it can't cover a large library and will miss most true duplicate pairs.
Hash-and-mod grouping just buckets data for sharding; items in the same bucket aren't necessarily similar, and true duplicates can land in different buckets.

scenario: 你已经有商品 embedding，面试官问它该进 ranker 还是只做召回。
scenario_en: You already have product embeddings, and the interviewer asks whether they belong in the ranker or only in retrieval.
q: 最合理的回答是什么？
q_en: What is the most reasonable answer?
options: embedding 只能用来做召回
embedding 只能当分类标签用
召回用相似度，ranker 也能把它当特征
embedding 只能用来做离线可视化
why: embedding 既能做 ANN 检索 key，也能作为 ranker 的紧凑语义特征，是否同时用取决于延迟和收益。
why_en: The same embedding can power retrieval by similarity and also serve as a compact feature for the ranker.
whenOtherWins: 如果 ranker 已有更强的原始多模态特征，直接喂 embedding 的边际收益可能较小。
tradeoff: 召回相似度用法 vs ranker 特征用法
options_en: Embeddings can only be used for retrieval.
Embeddings can only serve as a classification label.
Retrieval uses similarity, and the ranker can also use it as a feature.
Embeddings can only be used for offline visualization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对召回候选做精细排序、给出最终展示顺序的模型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A ranker is the model that finely sorts retrieved candidates to produce the final display order.

optionExplanations: 只做召回会漏掉一个便宜信号——同一份向量喂给 ranker 当特征，往往不需要额外训练成本。
分类标签是离散的监督目标，embedding 是连续向量，两者是完全不同的东西，不能互相替代。
对：召回阶段用它算相似度找候选，ranker 阶段又能把同一份向量当紧凑特征喂进去，一份向量吃两次。
可视化只是调试分析的手段之一，不是它在生产系统里的唯一用途，低估了它在召回和排序里的实际价值。
optionExplanations_en: Retrieval-only use misses a cheap signal — the same vector can also feed the ranker as a feature, usually at no extra training cost.
A classification label is a discrete supervision target while an embedding is a continuous vector — they're different things and can't substitute for each other.
Right: retrieval uses it to score similarity and find candidates, and the ranker can reuse the very same vector as a compact feature — one embedding, two jobs.
Visualization is just one debugging tool, not its only production use — this undersells its real value in retrieval and ranking.
